h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Orai

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Orai

items.pText: Orai is the headquarters of Jalaun district in the Bundelkhand region of Uttar Pradesh, a hot, dry part of the state with long summers. Many schools here have one or two teachers watching a whole ground at break. That makes the layout of a playground important, because every piece should be visible from where the supervising adult stands.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,000 km away. We send it to Orai by road and our installation team or a dealer installs it. Send us a photo of your ground taken from the staff room or the main building, along with the size and the classes that will use it. We will plan the layout around that view and mark the safe play area for each piece.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A layout one adult can supervise

c: Keep tall structures to the back of the play area and lower pieces in front, so nothing blocks the view from the building. Group the equipment in one zone instead of spreading it around the ground. A
helps here, because it puts slides, steps and climbers in a single footprint that one person can watch.
Leave a clear path from the classroom door to the play area. Bundelkhand summers are severe, so plan a shaded spot for the teacher too. Put
at one side, away from the path children use to cross the ground.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,000 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How should we arrange equipment so one teacher can watch it?
items.a: Group it in one zone, place taller pieces at the back and keep swings at the side. We plan the layout from a photo taken where the teacher usually stands.

items.q: Do you supply schools in Jalaun district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Orai and nearby towns, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment at your school.
Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle heat and dust well. Shade over slides and decks keeps them comfortable for children in the hotter months.
